### Borea v0.6.14

A patch release for compatibility in Discover. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Compatibility

- A mod now shows as incompatible when no version of its mod loader fits both the mod and the game build of your instance, for example a mod that needs StarMap 0.4.8 on a build that StarMap 0.4.8 does not run on. The chip says why, and Add, Update all, modpacks and the CLI warn before they install it. Thanks to @LaurensDeV for the report.
- The red Incompatible chip shows on every row again, also when every vehicle or save of the list is incompatible with your build.

Full changelog: [v0.6.13...v0.6.14](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.13...v0.6.14)
